title: fileattrib
summary: Return filesystem attribute metadata for a path.

gpu_support.notes: Host-side compatibility builtin; GPU-resident inputs are gathered before execution.

description: Return filesystem attribute metadata for a path.
behaviors: Reads file metadata and returns status plus an attribute struct containing Name, hidden, directory, and user/group/other permission flags.
Supports common writable flag mutation with +w and -w through the active filesystem provider.
Accepts read flags as no-op compatibility forms and rejects unsupported attribute flags explicitly.
